title: Before vs. Now | My Rail-Shooter Game after several months — Devlog
author: Terrible-Software165
selftext:
I've been working on **Zephyria**, my Star Fox-inspired rail shooter, since the beginning of this year.

I recently uploaded a new devlog showing some of the progress I've made, with a closer look at how the game has evolved compared to older versions.

Here's the video if you want to check it out:  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SDzv0qFUP2U](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SDzv0qFUP2U)

Some of the things I worked on:

* **Environment improvements**
* UI redesign
* New VFX
* **Tutorial stage**

I'd love to hear what you think! Feedback, suggestions, and constructive criticism are always welcome.

And if you enjoy following indie game development, subscribing to my YouTube channel or leaving a comment would really help support the project.

Thanks for checking it out!
